{"canvas_id":"F0C6JN5BAC9","markdown_content":"# Soulidity Delivery Hub

Foundation: Naoer. Labs delivery: Codex in the Labs CEO working role. Internal Agents build and support the products; external AI creator Agents are the core users.

## Working boards

* [Ecosystem milestones](https://sega-xya5661.slack.com/lists/T08LQTJFZRS/F0C6EQU2U5U)
* [Delivery tasks](https://sega-xya5661.slack.com/lists/T08LQTJFZRS/F0C6BEMB58V)

Slack Lists is the ecosystem task entry. Existing AC/SO CURRENT and Sprint cards remain authoritative for that active implementation; linked tracking rows are synchronized snapshots, not a second implementation queue. GitHub holds code, checks and release evidence. Linear is not required.

## Accountability

Naoer owns strategy, resources, partnerships and external commitments. Codex coordinates product priorities, engineering, verification and delivery. Each task has one role Owner and an independent reviewer. Role IDs do not imply Slack service accounts or minted Souls.

IRIS (SOL-L001): product and delivery. CIPHER (SOL-L002): protocol and architecture. SABLE (SOL-L003): creator tools and interaction. LUQI (SOL-L004): decentralized data access and recovery (no owned AC/SO business backend). FLUX (SOL-L005): integrations and games. SENTINEL (SOL-L006): QA. HARBOR (SOL-L007): DevOps. NOVA (SOL-F001): creator ecosystem. ECHO (SOL-F002): support.

## Cycle C01 · 3–16 October 2026

Cycle C01 is the ecosystem coordination window (3–16 October; review 10 October), not a replacement for the existing AC/SO Sprint cadence. No reminder or unattended scheduler has been configured.

Task flow: Backlog → Ready → In progress → Review → Done. Keep one integration stream and one platform stream; QA is independent. Do not mark a task Done for a plan, an unrun test or a deployment assumption.

## Agile + DevOps eight-stage loop · confirmed 5 October 2026

Plan → Code → Build → Test → Release → Deploy → Operate → Monitor → Plan. Agile sets small increments, priorities, reviews and retrospectives. Keep existing M1–M4/S0–S14, G1–G5, owners and task IDs; do not create eight separate boards.

* Plan — IRIS coordinates user outcomes, business rules, UI/UX including error states, applicable pricing/cost hypotheses and risk; exit with executable acceptance and one owner/reviewer. Foundation owns commercial decisions.
* Code — SABLE/CIPHER/LUQI/FLUX implement the linked scope and review exact changes (G1).
* Build — implementation owner/HARBOR record reproducible artifacts, source/build identity and cross-repository configuration (G2).
* Test — SENTINEL verifies normal, failure, recovery and affected security/user flows against the same candidate; record gaps (applicable G1–G3).
* Release — delivery lead/SENTINEL/HARBOR check G3, the exact release manifest, residual risk, authorization and recovery plan.
* Deploy — authorized release executor verifies the exact target and real readback (G4); deployment alone is not user acceptance.
* Operate — HARBOR/ECHO handle support, incidents, dependencies, costs and recovery; query successful transactions before resuming (G5).
* Monitor — HARBOR/IRIS/NOVA/ECHO capture technical and user outcomes, observation window and evidence; feed findings into the original DEV/BUG and next Plan.

Existing [Product development](https://sega-xya5661.slack.com/lists/T08LQTJFZRS/F0C6DCP5VFH), [Bug tracking](https://sega-xya5661.slack.com/lists/T08LQTJFZRS/F0C6UK635UJ) and Delivery now use DevOps 阶段 and 阶段证据／退出条件. Stage is independent of status. Blank historical stage means unverified; owners fill it from evidence when actually advancing/reviewing the record. Append date, candidate/environment, evidence, result, remaining exit criteria and next owner/action; N/A needs a reason.

Production bugs close only after the original deployed operation passes. Build/test-only defects close in their original failing environment with any production N/A explained. Design completion is not implementation or release; ongoing operations are handed to a named owner instead of keeping every development card open forever.

Risk, security and quality span the loop; retain existing severity/priority and independent review of high-risk changes. No mandatory new R0–R3 scale. This process update does not enable CI, alerts, schedules, deployment or signing. Canonical details: agent-management/OPERATING_MODEL.md §8; linked AC AGILE_DELIVERY_PLAN maps existing gates.

## Current source boundary

Authoritative implementation is the active chat “Unified Maker v8 Market execution”: AC worktree tmp/animacraft-v8-mainnet-release, SO worktree /Users/naoer/.codex/worktrees/f722/soulidity. Its original M1–M4 and S0–S14 remain unchanged. This board labels them AC-SO-M1–M4; ecosystem milestones use ECO-0–ECO-6. AC/SO confirmed architecture is chain + frontend, with no owned business backend.

* [Animacraft current-source reference](https://github.com/redefine-digital-labs/animacraft/tree/592699af0eb8bd5cd0015b0898fbb45f2cbdef0e)
* [Soulidity current-source reference](https://github.com/redefine-digital-labs/soulidity/tree/3a1f223ef3f88fef529d08e44183697595d714ef)
* [Animacraft passing check](https://github.com/redefine-digital-labs/animacraft/actions/runs/37120964860)
* [Soulidity passing check](https://github.com/redefine-digital-labs/soulidity/actions/runs/37116966506)

## Agents actually started

IRIS completed the first-cycle requirements review. HARBOR completed a read-only CI inventory. The workflow named Repository hygiene includes real Web and Move checks; it is not just documentation hygiene. Product tests for Engine/templates/Stellar and desktop release execution remain distinct gaps to assess.

MIRA (CREATOR-001) completed an internal public-entry discovery run. ATLAS (CREATOR-002, scene author) and LYRA (CREATOR-003, narrative creator) are registered profiles awaiting their verified environments. No creator has completed two-round artwork creation in this bootstrap; internal trials are not external adoption.

MIRA observed a discoverable Creator Studio entry and local editing documentation, but the existing browser was already wallet-connected and contained local drafts. No wallet state or draft was changed. Anonymous editing/export and deployed build identity remain unverified.

## Execution boundaries

Agents run as bounded task sessions; no unattended daemon, individual Slack bots or automatic signing are configured. Product implementation must use the correct active workspace and avoid taking over existing PRs. Publishing, money, chain signatures and external outreach require their own authorization. Independent internal QA is not an external security audit.

ECO-0 remains active. The current implementation records S12/G4 fresh chain release and two-site cutover complete. S13-F01-B native image geometry repair is in paired PRs AC#59 and SO#32; candidate CI/artifact checks and full wallet/mobile/protected journeys remain open. The four original product milestones are not complete. Do not rerun the finalized chain release.

## Bootstrap acceptance · 3 October 2026

SENTINEL independent correction review passed: 11 milestone records, 20 tasks, nine role contracts and three internal creator profiles. PLAN-002, PLAN-003, PLAN-006A, PILOT-016, OPS-018, OPS-019 and QA-017 are Done for their bounded management/discovery scopes. ECO-0, original product milestones, operational recovery verification and two-round creator product trials remain open. Evidence: agent-management/runs/2026-10-03-bootstrap/SENTINEL.md.
